definitions.gloss: every other year; biennial; alternate years
definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two years, or the interval of one year between occurrences.

examples.japanese: {隔年|かくねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: It is held every other year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔年|かくねん}⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧だ。
⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、{隔年|かくねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I get a health checkup every other year, not every year.

notes:
A compound of {隔|かく} (interval, alternate) and ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year). The prefix {隔|かく} is productive and appears in similar time-interval words.

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier with で or as a prefix: {隔年|かくねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (every other year), {隔年|かくねん}⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧ (biennial event). Common in formal and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔年|かくねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧ — to hold every other year
- {隔年|かくねん}⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧ — biennial implementation
- {隔年|かくねん}⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ — published every other year
